en: Vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard. The picture side shows four photographs from the city of Pécs, Hungary: the ornate City Hall building labeled "Városháza"; a wooded hillside scene with a building labeled "Üdülőszálló" (holiday hotel); a grand cathedral with towers and cascading fountains labeled "Székesegyház"; and a wide street view labeled "Ferenc József út", with tram tracks and buildings leading toward distant hills. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, address lines, a Hungarian stamp reading "MAGYAR KIR. POSTA" with a postmark, and the printer's mark "FOTO WEINSTOCK" and code "4206/41. sz."
